description: This file provides helper functions for manipulating 2D and 3D tables, including setting linear curves, RPM bins, and table bins. It includes methods for initializing table axes with specific ranges and rounding precision.

methods.name: void setLinearCurve(float array[],int size,float from,float to,float precision)
methods.description: Fills an array with linearly interpolated values between 'from' and 'to' based on specified precision.

methods.name: void setRpmBin(float array[],int size,float idleRpm,float topRpm)
methods.description: Populates an array with RPM bin values, starting from an adjusted idle RPM to the top RPM.

methods.name: void setTableBin(float array[],int size,float from,float to)
methods.description: Sets an array as a linear curve between two values with a fixed precision.

methods.name: void setRpmTableBin(float array[],int size)
methods.description: Initializes an RPM table axis with a default RPM range from 800 to 7000.
